florian.title: Hi, I'm Florian 👋
florian.body: Hi, my name is Florian, I'm 19 and I created REVS because I've always been passionate about cars. I wanted a real community where we share our finest automotive encounters, where every spot counts and where we collect our dream cars. Welcome aboard — I can't wait to see what you'll spot.

dreamCar.title: What's your dream car?
dreamCar.subtitle: The one you'd love to spot (or own).

interests.title: What gets your heart racing?
interests.subtitle: Pick everything you love — at least one.

source.title: How did you hear about REVS?
source.subtitle: It helps us know where to focus.

notifications.title: Stay in the race 🔔
notifications.subtitle: Turn on notifications to get alerted when a supercar is spotted near you, and when you climb the leaderboard.

location.title: Spot around you 📍
location.subtitle: REVS uses your location to place your spots on the map and show you cars spotted nearby. You can turn it off anytime.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.subtitle: REVS works thanks to everyone's respect. Before you start:

items.respect: Respect other spotters and their cars.
items.privacy: Never post readable plates or faces — we blur them automatically.
items.safety: Spot safely: never while driving, never on the road.
items.authentic: Post your own photos, taken by you.
